title: 【RPG Design Guides】Early Game ② Setting Out

blocks.source: 【RPG制作講座】序盤② 旅立ち
blocks.translation: 【RPG Design Guides】Early Game ② Setting Out

blocks.source: オープニングによって物語が始まり、舞台の基本説明を終えたならば、いよいよ主人公が旅立つことになる。既に物語の開始時点で旅立っている作品もたまにあるが、ほとんどの作品では旅立つまでの流れを作ることになる。
blocks.translation: Once the story has begun through the opening and the basic setting has been explained, it is finally time for the protagonist to set out on a journey. There are occasionally works in which the protagonist has already set out when the story begins, but most works need to create a sequence of events leading up to the departure.

blocks.source: 旅立たせる方法は大きく分けて２種類。
blocks.translation: There are two broad ways to send the protagonist on their journey.

blocks.source: 動機を与えて、自ら旅立たせる。
blocks.translation: Give the protagonist a reason to set out of their own accord.

blocks.source: 住む場所を追われるなどして、旅立たざるを得なくする。
blocks.translation: Put the protagonist in a situation where they have no choice but to leave, such as being driven from their home.

blocks.source: 最初から主人公が明確に大きな目的を持っているならば、難しく考える必要はない。
blocks.translation: If the protagonist has had a clear, major goal from the beginning, there is no need to overthink it.

blocks.source: そうでない場合（特に２．）は、当面の旅立つきっかけを与えて、大きな目標を得るまでの繋ぎを行う必要がある。
blocks.translation: Otherwise (especially in the second case), you need to provide an immediate reason to set out and bridge the gap until the protagonist obtains a major goal.

blocks.source: ２．の場合も結局は１．に繋がるパターンが大半である。
blocks.translation: Even in the second case, most stories eventually lead into the first.

blocks.source: それでは主な旅立ちのパターンを挙げて行きたい。
blocks.translation: Now, I would like to go over some common patterns for setting out on a journey.

blocks.source: 以下のパターンを１つないし、複数経由して旅が始まることが多い。
blocks.translation: A journey often begins by passing through one or more of the following patterns.

blocks.source: 旅立ちのパターン
blocks.translation: Patterns for Setting Out

blocks.source: 指示
blocks.translation: Instructions

blocks.source: 旅立つきっかけとなる指示を得る。
blocks.translation: The protagonist receives instructions that provide a reason to set out.

blocks.source: 王様・神様あるいは母ちゃんのような偉い人から指示を受けるという形状が最もシンプル。
blocks.translation: The simplest form is to receive instructions from an important person such as a king, a god, or one's mother.

blocks.source: 『指示』という言葉を使っているが、『頼み』なども構造はほぼ同じ。
blocks.translation: Although I use the word “instructions,” a “request” and similar concepts have essentially the same structure.

blocks.source: ドラゴンクエスト１～３
blocks.translation: Dragon Quest I–III

blocks.source: 「勇者よ。魔王を倒すのじゃ！」というように、いきなり最終目的に直結するような指示を受けるパターン。ＤＱ３の場合は一応、父に関わる因縁が語られる。
blocks.translation: The protagonist receives instructions that immediately connect to the ultimate goal, such as, “Luminary, you must defeat the Demon King!” In Dragon Quest III, there is at least some explanation of the connection involving the protagonist's father.

blocks.source: ドラゴンクエスト５
blocks.translation: Dragon Quest V

blocks.source: 序盤は大きな目的もなく、父に付属する形で物語が進む。少年期の最後、父の死亡によって、ようやく目的を得る。
blocks.translation: At first, the story progresses with no major goal, with the protagonist accompanying their father. Only at the end of childhood, when the protagonist's father dies, do they finally acquire a purpose.

blocks.source: 「お前の母さんは生きている。わしに代わって母さんを。ぬわーーっっ！！」
blocks.translation: “Your mother is still alive. Find your mother in my place. Nuuwaaah!!”

blocks.source: という遺言によって、奴隷時代を経て母を探すことになる。このように劇的な場面で指示を与えると印象深い。
blocks.translation: Because of these dying words, the protagonist eventually searches for their mother after passing through a period of slavery. Giving instructions in such a dramatic scene leaves a lasting impression.

blocks.source: ファイナルファンタジー８
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy VIII

blocks.source: 「炎の洞窟で試験を受けろ」というような簡単なお使いイベントから開始。
blocks.translation: The story begins with a simple errand quest, such as, “Take the test at the Fire Cavern.”

blocks.source: 以降も、徐々に大きな課題を与えられていく中で「魔女を倒す」という大目的を得ることになる。
blocks.translation: As the protagonist is gradually given increasingly difficult tasks, they eventually acquire the major goal of “defeating the sorceress.”

blocks.source: こうやって、小さなイベントから徐々に話を広げていくのも定番。
blocks.translation: Gradually expanding the story from small events in this way is also a classic approach.

blocks.source: 決意
blocks.translation: Determination

blocks.source: 主人公自身が旅立ちを決意する。「俺は勇者になって魔王を倒す！」ってな具合。
blocks.translation: The protagonist themself decides to set out. Something like, “I’ll become a Luminary and defeat the Demon King!”

blocks.source: どちらかと言うと喋る主人公向きだが、無口主人公でも他者や仲間のセリフを借りる形で可能。
blocks.translation: This is more suited to a talkative protagonist, but it can also work with a silent protagonist by having other characters or companions provide the dialogue.

blocks.source: 例えば、「お前、勇者を目指すんだって？」あるいは「俺達で世界を救うぞ！」と、主人公の目的を断定してしまうやり方がある。
blocks.translation: For example, someone might state the protagonist's goal outright by saying, “I hear you’re aiming to become a Luminary?” or “We’re going to save the world!”

blocks.source: 他のパターンを経由して、最終的に決意に至るというパターンが多い。自発的に旅をしているという時点で、大なり小なり決意しているのは当たり前だけど……。
blocks.translation: Often, the protagonist reaches this determination after passing through another pattern. After all, the very fact that someone is traveling of their own accord means they have made a decision of one kind or another...

blocks.source: ファイナルファンタジー４
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy IV

blocks.source: 主人公セシルはオープニングの出来事で国王のやり方に疑問を持つ。そして、親友カインと共に最後の任務を終えて、国を出ることを決意する。
blocks.translation: The protagonist Cecil begins to question the king's methods because of the events in the opening. After completing one final mission with his best friend Kain, he decides to leave the country.

blocks.source: 所属組織からの離反というのも、旅立ちのきっかけとしては中々面白いと思う。
blocks.translation: Defecting from the organization the protagonist belongs to can also be a fairly interesting reason to set out.

blocks.source: 最初から目的を持っている
blocks.translation: Having a Goal from the Beginning

blocks.source: 物語が開始した時点で主人公は既に明確な目的を持って旅をしている。プレイヤーには後を追ってその説明を行う。
blocks.translation: When the story begins, the protagonist is already traveling with a clear goal. The player is then given an explanation of it afterward.

blocks.source: ドラゴンクエスト８
blocks.translation: Dragon Quest VIII

blocks.source: 主人公は王国の兵士。王と姫の呪いを解く事が旅の目的であり、物語開始時点で既に旅の途中である。
blocks.translation: The protagonist is a soldier of the kingdom. The purpose of the journey is to break the curse placed on the king and princess, and the protagonist is already partway through the journey when the story begins.

blocks.source: 呪いをかけられた経緯は序盤、回想の形で示される。
blocks.translation: The circumstances surrounding the curse are shown early on in the form of a flashback.

blocks.source: 出会い
blocks.translation: A Meeting

blocks.source: 出会った誰かが旅の動機をもたらす。
blocks.translation: Someone the protagonist meets provides the motivation for the journey.

blocks.source: 偶然、助けた人物が逃亡中のお姫様で、それに協力する形になるだとか。
blocks.translation: For example, the person they happen to rescue turns out to be a princess on the run, and the protagonist ends up helping her.

blocks.source: ボーイミーツガールの定番。
blocks.translation: A classic boy-meets-girl setup.

blocks.source: ファイナルファンタジー５
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy V

blocks.source: オープニングで出会った仲間の目的（クリスタルを守る）に主人公が乗っかる。
blocks.translation: The protagonist joins in with the goal of the companions they meet in the opening: protecting the crystals.

blocks.source: その後、実は主人公自身もその目的に因縁があることが明かされる。
blocks.translation: Later, it is revealed that the protagonist themself is also connected to that goal.

blocks.source: ＦＦ６、７、９、１０、１２も他者に乗っかるのは同じである。
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy VI, VII, IX, X, and XII also follow the same pattern of the protagonist joining someone else's cause.

blocks.source: どこかに飛ばされて
blocks.translation: Being Sent Somewhere

blocks.source: どこかに何らかの要因で飛ばされる。
blocks.translation: The protagonist is sent somewhere due to some sort of circumstance.

blocks.source: 元の場所に戻るために奮闘する内に、世界の情勢を知り、何らかの目的を見つけるといった展開が多い。
blocks.translation: A common development is that, while struggling to return to their original location, the protagonist learns about the state of the world and discovers some kind of purpose.

blocks.source: 船や飛行機の事故でどこかにたどり着くというのが多い。
blocks.translation: It is common for the protagonist to end up somewhere after an accident involving a ship or airplane.

blocks.source: タイムトラベルものや異世界ファンタジーは、大抵これが起点となる。
blocks.translation: This is usually where time-travel stories and otherworldly fantasy stories begin.

blocks.source: クロノトリガー
blocks.translation: Chrono Trigger

blocks.source: 祭りの催しにあった装置がヒロインの持つペンダントと反応して、タイムワープを引き起こす。
blocks.translation: A device at a festival reacts with the pendant worn by the heroine, causing a time warp.

blocks.source: 後を追った主人公は中世の時代にたどり着く。
blocks.translation: The protagonist follows after her and arrives in the medieval era.

blocks.source: やがて、未来に待ち受ける世界崩壊を知った主人公達はそれを阻止する決心を固める。
blocks.translation: Eventually, after learning of the world's impending destruction in the future, the protagonists resolve to prevent it.

blocks.source: テイルズオブジアビス
blocks.translation: Tales of the Abyss

blocks.source: 主人公が暮らす屋敷に単身乗り込んでくるヒロイン。
blocks.translation: The heroine arrives alone at the mansion where the protagonist lives.

blocks.source: ……が、主人公とヒロインの力が共鳴（超振動）してワープ。主人公は屋敷に戻る過程で、様々な人物と出会う。箱入り息子であった主人公も世界の情勢を知っていくという流れ。
blocks.translation: ...But the powers of the protagonist and heroine resonate (hyperresonance), warping them away. On his way back to the mansion, the protagonist meets various people. The sheltered young man gradually learns about the state of the world.

blocks.source: でもこれ、結構強引な導入な気がしないでもない。都合の良い超振動といい、ここだけやたら無鉄砲なヒロインといい……。
blocks.translation: Still, I can't help feeling that this is a rather forced introduction. The conveniently timed hyperresonance, and the heroine being unusually reckless here...

blocks.source: 危機
blocks.translation: Crisis

blocks.source: 主人公や家族、仲間、住む町が危機に見舞われるパターン。
blocks.translation: A pattern in which the protagonist, their family, companions, or hometown is thrown into crisis.

blocks.source: 例えば、主人公の住む国が敵軍に襲われて……というのは定番。
blocks.translation: For example, the protagonist's country is attacked by an enemy army... That's a classic.

blocks.source: そこからの繋げ方としては……
blocks.translation: Possible ways to continue from there include...

blocks.source: 主人公は国を脱出。
blocks.translation: The protagonist escapes the country.

blocks.source: 主人公は敵に捕らわれる。
blocks.translation: The protagonist is captured by the enemy.

blocks.source: 主人公が覚醒して危機を脱出するが、その力を周囲から白眼視される。
blocks.translation: The protagonist awakens and escapes the crisis, but those around them look upon their power with disdain.

blocks.source: 主人公の家族や友人が命を落としたり、さらわれたり。
blocks.translation: The protagonist's family or friends are killed or kidnapped.

blocks.source: という具合によりどりみどり。
blocks.translation: There are plenty of options.

blocks.source: ごく普通の日常から急激な破綻を迎えるというパターンも多用される。
blocks.translation: The pattern of going from an utterly ordinary daily life to a sudden collapse is also used frequently.

blocks.source: 特に平穏な日常と危機のギャップが大きいほど、インパクトが強くなる。
blocks.translation: The greater the contrast between peaceful daily life and the crisis, the stronger the impact.

blocks.source: そこから、失ったものを取り戻すため、あるいは復讐のために戦うというように、強い動機づけになる。
blocks.translation: This provides strong motivation, such as fighting to recover what was lost or to seek revenge.

blocks.source: ドラゴンクエスト4（５章）
blocks.translation: Dragon Quest IV (Chapter 5)

blocks.source: 平穏な日常が急激な破綻を迎えるパターンの代表。日常部分はかなり短め。
blocks.translation: A prime example of the pattern in which peaceful daily life suddenly collapses. The everyday-life portion is quite brief.

blocks.source: 住んでいた村が魔族に滅ぼされ、１人生き残った主人公は旅に出ざるを得なくなる。
blocks.translation: After the village where the protagonist lived is destroyed by monsters, the lone survivor has no choice but to set out on a journey.

blocks.source: 追放
blocks.translation: Exile

blocks.source: 住んでいた町や所属していた組織から追い出されて、やはり旅に出ざるを得なくなる。
blocks.translation: The protagonist is driven out of the town where they lived or the organization they belonged to, and once again has no choice but to set out on a journey.

blocks.source: そこからいくつかのイベントを経て、旅の目的を得るというパターンが多い。
blocks.translation: A common pattern is to gain a purpose for the journey after going through several events.

blocks.source: 聖剣伝説2
blocks.translation: Secret of Mana

blocks.source: 主人公が聖剣を抜いたことがきっかけとなって、辺りに魔物が現れる。周りに白眼視された主人公は村を追い出される。
blocks.translation: When the protagonist pulls out the sacred sword, monsters begin appearing in the area. Shunned by those around him, the protagonist is driven out of the village.

blocks.source: 脱出
blocks.translation: Escape

blocks.source: 開始時点で既に牢獄など、囚われた状況にある場合。そこからの脱出や逃亡が最初のイベントとなり得る。
blocks.translation: The protagonist is already trapped somewhere, such as a prison, when the story begins. Escaping or fleeing from there can serve as the first event.

blocks.source: 脱出してから何を目的とするかは追って決めても良い。
blocks.translation: It is fine to decide later what the protagonist's objective will be after escaping.

blocks.source: 意外と例がないのだが、導入部としては見せ場もできるし悪くないと思う。
blocks.translation: There are surprisingly few examples, but I think it works well as an introduction and provides an opportunity for a memorable scene.

blocks.source: 聖剣伝説１
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy Adventure

blocks.source: 奴隷剣闘士として戦いの日々を送っていた主人公は、仲間の死をきっかけに闘技場からの脱出を決意。
blocks.translation: The protagonist has spent his days fighting as a slave gladiator, but the death of a companion leads him to decide to escape from the arena.

blocks.source: モンスターの出入口から脱出に成功する。その後は滝から落ちる→ヒロインと出会う→ヒロインさらわれる……というような展開。
blocks.translation: He successfully escapes through the monsters' entrance. After that, the story unfolds with him falling from a waterfall → meeting the heroine → the heroine being kidnapped...

blocks.source: 旅立たない
blocks.translation: Not Setting Out on a Journey

blocks.source: 別に旅立たなくても良いじゃないかという発想。特定の場所を拠点に発生する事件を解決していく方法が主流となる。
blocks.translation: The idea is that there is no need to set out on a journey at all. The main approach is to solve incidents that occur around a specific base of operations.

blocks.source: 受け身のストーリー進行になりやすいが、そういう作品があっても悪くはないだろう。
blocks.translation: This tends to result in a passive story progression, but there is nothing wrong with works like that.

blocks.source: 序盤に限り拠点を中心に行動するが、途中から外へ旅立つアークザラッド２のようなスタイルもある。
blocks.translation: There are also styles like Arc the Lad II, which centers on a base only in the early stages before setting out into the outside world partway through.

blocks.source: ペルソナ４
blocks.translation: Persona 4

blocks.source: 自宅や学校など、町を中心に物語が進行する。
blocks.translation: The story progresses mainly around the town, including the protagonist's home and school.

blocks.source: ペルソナの力を手に入れた主人公達は、次々と発生する事件を解決するために尽力していく。
blocks.translation: After gaining the power of Personas, the protagonists work to solve the incidents that occur one after another.

blocks.source: 英雄伝説 零の奇跡
blocks.translation: The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero

blocks.source: 警察の捜査官として、町に発生する事件を解決していく中で巨大な陰謀に気づいていく、という筋書き。
blocks.translation: The story follows police investigators who uncover a massive conspiracy while solving incidents that occur throughout the city.

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Conclusion

blocks.source: 旅立つきっかけの作り方を思いつく限りで挙げてみた。前回と今回の記事を合わせて、序盤の展開に悩んでいるという方の参考になれば幸い。
blocks.translation: I have listed as many ways to create a reason to set out on a journey as I could think of. I hope this article, together with the previous one, will be helpful to those struggling with how to develop the early part of their story.

blocks.source: なお、『序盤』と書いたが、別に物語中盤に使用しても問題ない展開も多い。
blocks.translation: Although I referred to the "early part," many of these developments can also be used in the middle of a story without any problem.

blocks.source: あくまで大雑把なパターン分けなので、細部では様々な手法がある。色々と工夫をしてみて欲しい。
blocks.translation: These are only rough categories, so there are various techniques to be found in the details. I hope you will experiment and devise your own approaches.

texts.最初から目的を持っている: Having a Goal from the Beginning
texts.物語が開始した時点で主人公は既に明確な目的を持って旅をしている。プレイヤーには後: When the story begins, the protagonist is already traveling with a clear goal. The player is then given an explanation of it afterward.
texts.主人公は王国の兵士。王と姫の呪いを解く事が旅の目的であり、物語開始時点で既に旅の: The protagonist is a soldier of the kingdom. The purpose of the journey is to break the curse placed on the king and princess, and the protagonist is already partway through the journey when the story begins.
texts.呪いをかけられた経緯は序盤、回想の形で示される。: The circumstances surrounding the curse are shown early on in the form of a flashback.
texts.出会った誰かが旅の動機をもたらす。: Someone the protagonist meets provides the motivation for the journey.
texts.偶然、助けた人物が逃亡中のお姫様で、それに協力する形になるだとか。: For example, the person they happen to rescue turns out to be a princess on the run, and the protagonist ends up helping her.
texts.オープニングで出会った仲間の目的（クリスタルを守る）に主人公が乗っかる。: The protagonist joins in with the goal of the companions they meet in the opening: protecting the crystals.
texts.その後、実は主人公自身もその目的に因縁があることが明かされる。: Later, it is revealed that the protagonist themself is also connected to that goal.
texts.ＦＦ６、７、９、１０、１２も他者に乗っかるのは同じである。: Final Fantasy VI, VII, IX, X, and XII also follow the same pattern of the protagonist joining someone else's cause.
texts.どこかに何らかの要因で飛ばされる。: The protagonist is sent somewhere due to some sort of circumstance.
texts.元の場所に戻るために奮闘する内に、世界の情勢を知り、何らかの目的を見つけるといっ: A common development is that, while struggling to return to their original location, the protagonist learns about the state of the world and discovers some kind of purpose.
texts.船や飛行機の事故でどこかにたどり着くというのが多い。: It is common for the protagonist to end up somewhere after an accident involving a ship or airplane.
texts.タイムトラベルものや異世界ファンタジーは、大抵これが起点となる。: This is usually where time-travel stories and otherworldly fantasy stories begin.
texts.祭りの催しにあった装置がヒロインの持つペンダントと反応して、タイムワープを引き起: A device at a festival reacts with the pendant worn by the heroine, causing a time warp.
texts.後を追った主人公は中世の時代にたどり着く。: The protagonist follows after her and arrives in the medieval era.
texts.やがて、未来に待ち受ける世界崩壊を知った主人公達はそれを阻止する決心を固める。: Eventually, after learning of the world's impending destruction in the future, the protagonists resolve to prevent it.
texts.主人公が暮らす屋敷に単身乗り込んでくるヒロイン。: The heroine arrives alone at the mansion where the protagonist lives.
texts.……が、主人公とヒロインの力が共鳴（超振動）してワープ。主人公は屋敷に戻る過程で: ...But the powers of the protagonist and heroine resonate (hyperresonance), warping them away. On his way back to the mansion, the protagonist meets various people. The sheltered young man gradually learns about the state of the world.
texts.でもこれ、結構強引な導入な気がしないでもない。都合の良い超振動といい、ここだけや: Still, I can't help feeling that this is a rather forced introduction. The conveniently timed hyperresonance, and the heroine being unusually reckless here...
texts.主人公や家族、仲間、住む町が危機に見舞われるパターン。: A pattern in which the protagonist, their family, companions, or hometown is thrown into crisis.
texts.例えば、主人公の住む国が敵軍に襲われて……というのは定番。: For example, the protagonist's country is attacked by an enemy army... That's a classic.
texts.そこからの繋げ方としては……: Possible ways to continue from there include...
texts.主人公は敵に捕らわれる。: The protagonist is captured by the enemy.
texts.主人公が覚醒して危機を脱出するが、その力を周囲から白眼視される。: The protagonist awakens and escapes the crisis, but those around them look upon their power with disdain.
texts.主人公の家族や友人が命を落としたり、さらわれたり。: The protagonist's family or friends are killed or kidnapped.
texts.ごく普通の日常から急激な破綻を迎えるというパターンも多用される。: The pattern of going from an utterly ordinary daily life to a sudden collapse is also used frequently.
texts.特に平穏な日常と危機のギャップが大きいほど、インパクトが強くなる。: The greater the contrast between peaceful daily life and the crisis, the stronger the impact.
texts.そこから、失ったものを取り戻すため、あるいは復讐のために戦うというように、強い動: This provides strong motivation, such as fighting to recover what was lost or to seek revenge.
texts.平穏な日常が急激な破綻を迎えるパターンの代表。日常部分はかなり短め。: A prime example of the pattern in which peaceful daily life suddenly collapses. The everyday-life portion is quite brief.
texts.住んでいた村が魔族に滅ぼされ、１人生き残った主人公は旅に出ざるを得なくなる。: After the village where the protagonist lived is destroyed by monsters, the lone survivor has no choice but to set out on a journey.
texts.住んでいた町や所属していた組織から追い出されて、やはり旅に出ざるを得なくなる。: The protagonist is driven out of the town where they lived or the organization they belonged to, and once again has no choice but to set out on a journey.
texts.そこからいくつかのイベントを経て、旅の目的を得るというパターンが多い。: A common pattern is to gain a purpose for the journey after going through several events.
texts.主人公が聖剣を抜いたことがきっかけとなって、辺りに魔物が現れる。周りに白眼視され: When the protagonist pulls out the sacred sword, monsters begin appearing in the area. Shunned by those around him, the protagonist is driven out of the village.
texts.開始時点で既に牢獄など、囚われた状況にある場合。そこからの脱出や逃亡が最初のイベ: The protagonist is already trapped somewhere, such as a prison, when the story begins. Escaping or fleeing from there can serve as the first event.
texts.脱出してから何を目的とするかは追って決めても良い。: It is fine to decide later what the protagonist's objective will be after escaping.
texts.意外と例がないのだが、導入部としては見せ場もできるし悪くないと思う。: There are surprisingly few examples, but I think it works well as an introduction and provides an opportunity for a memorable scene.
texts.奴隷剣闘士として戦いの日々を送っていた主人公は、仲間の死をきっかけに闘技場からの: The protagonist has spent his days fighting as a slave gladiator, but the death of a companion leads him to decide to escape from the arena.
texts.モンスターの出入口から脱出に成功する。その後は滝から落ちる→ヒロインと出会う→ヒ: He successfully escapes through the monsters' entrance. After that, the story unfolds with him falling from a waterfall → meeting the heroine → the heroine being kidnapped...
texts.旅立たない: Not Setting Out on a Journey
texts.別に旅立たなくても良いじゃないかという発想。特定の場所を拠点に発生する事件を解決: The idea is that there is no need to set out on a journey at all. The main approach is to solve incidents that occur around a specific base of operations.
texts.受け身のストーリー進行になりやすいが、そういう作品があっても悪くはないだろう。: This tends to result in a passive story progression, but there is nothing wrong with works like that.
texts.序盤に限り拠点を中心に行動するが、途中から外へ旅立つアークザラッド２のようなスタ: There are also styles like Arc the Lad II, which centers on a base only in the early stages before setting out into the outside world partway through.
texts.自宅や学校など、町を中心に物語が進行する。: The story progresses mainly around the town, including the protagonist's home and school.
texts.ペルソナの力を手に入れた主人公達は、次々と発生する事件を解決するために尽力してい: After gaining the power of Personas, the protagonists work to solve the incidents that occur one after another.
texts.英雄伝説 零の奇跡: The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero
texts.警察の捜査官として、町に発生する事件を解決していく中で巨大な陰謀に気づいていく、: The story follows police investigators who uncover a massive conspiracy while solving incidents that occur throughout the city.
texts.旅立つきっかけの作り方を思いつく限りで挙げてみた。前回と今回の記事を合わせて、序: I have listed as many ways to create a reason to set out on a journey as I could think of. I hope this article, together with the previous one, will be helpful to those struggling with how to develop the early part of their story.
texts.なお、『序盤』と書いたが、別に物語中盤に使用しても問題ない展開も多い。: Although I referred to the "early part," many of these developments can also be used in the middle of a story without any problem.
texts.あくまで大雑把なパターン分けなので、細部では様々な手法がある。色々と工夫をしてみ: These are only rough categories, so there are various techniques to be found in the details. I hope you will experiment and devise your own approaches.
